name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Jorgen sends trusted operatives across Stormwind with a sealed note for Elling Trias. The delivery carries the search for the missing diplomat from the Valley of Heroes to Trias' Cheese in the Trade District.

sections.title: A Discreet Delivery
sections.body: After the first inquiries into the diplomat's disappearance, Jorgen asks trusted operatives to keep silent and carry a sealed note across the city. It is meant for Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District, not a barracks or magistrate's office. The handoff avoids ordinary guard channels as concern over the missing diplomat reaches beyond the palace.

sections.title: Behind the Shopfront
sections.body: Elling Trias is a jovial, hardworking cheesemonger and respected merchant at Trias' Cheese. His history with Jorgen and his own contacts reach beyond the shop. With Jorgen's note delivered, the search for the missing diplomat passes quietly into Trias' hands.

faq.answer: Elling Trias is a respected merchant who runs Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District. He shares some history with Jorgen and has contacts he can use in delicate matters.

faq.q: Why does Jorgen tell me to keep quiet?
faq.answer: Jorgen demands silence because the diplomat's disappearance is a state secret. Word could stir panic or alert whoever orchestrated the abduction, betraying that an investigation is underway.

faq.q: Where can I find Trias' Cheese?
faq.answer: Trias' Cheese is in Stormwind City's Trade District, along the main avenues among merchants and craftsmen.

faq.q: What is in the sealed note to Elling?
faq.answer: Jorgen's sealed note briefs Elling Trias about the missing diplomat and calls on him to use his contacts and underground ears to find tracks conventional authorities cannot trace.

faq.q: Who is the missing diplomat mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The royal court guards the diplomat's identity at this stage. The secrecy and concern point to someone of immense political significance to the Kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: Why would the investigation use a cheesemonger instead of the city guard?
faq.answer: The city guard is bound by protocol, jurisdiction, and political ties. Elling Trias can reach street whispers and quiet contacts beyond the soldiers' reach.

angles.text: As a rogue, you may suspect Trias' Cheese is more than a dairy storefront. Its owner keeps quiet contacts well beyond the Trade District.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the quiet pursuit of the missing envoy reveals subtle vulnerabilities in Stormwind's leadership.
